source_text: Non est distinctio: omnes enim peccaverunt et egent gloria Dei. Iustitia Dei per fidem Iesu Christi in omnes qui credunt — non ex operibus legis, gratis per redemptionem quae est in Christo Iesu.
pass_a_gloss: There is no distinction: for all have sinned and lack the glory of God. The righteousness of God through faith of Jesus Christ unto all who believe — not from works of the law, freely through the redemption which is in Christ Jesus.
pass_b_english: [[There is no distinction; all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God >> Bible:Romans 3:22-23]]. [[They are justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus >> Bible:Romans 3:24]].
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Romans; do not copy Scheck FOTC
